book.name: 1 Timoteo
book.title: Enyaarubha yo okutaanga ya Pauro ku Timoteo

content: Ambe, obhweemero bhwa goosi, nirakusabha awe hamwe na abhiikirirya bhoosi mubhe murasabhira abhaatu bhoosi, kumasabhi ga maanga goosi. Kweeki, mubhe muramubhuurira Taatabhugya “Ozomirye” kwiiguru ya abhaatu bhoosi.
Mureenderwa kubhasabhira abhatemi na abhaandi bhoosi bho obhukaangati, okubha twiikare kwo omureembe, tumutuniirire Taatabhugya no okubha ne eteemwa nzomu.
Eriingʼana rino ni zomu, kweeki riramuzomera Taatabhugya Omutuurya weetu.
Ewe areenda abhaatu bhoosi bhatuuribhwe, no okumenya obhuheene.
Tumenyiri kubha gayo ni go obhuheene, kwo okubha ariho Taatabhugya wumwe ego, no omuutu wumwe wuno okwiigwaania abhaatu na Taatabhugya, neewe ni Krisito Yeesu.
Ewe akaruusya obhwiikari bhwaaye omweene, okubha abhatuurye abhaatu bhoosi. Bhuno nibhwo obhweerekenio bhuno Taatabhugya akatuha, kwiibhaga rino yateeriho.
Na kwe ekigirirye kiyo, enye nikatuurwa kubha omweega nigeende okurwaaza no okweegya bharya bhatari Abhayahudi amangʼana go obhwiikirirya no obhuheene. Niragaamba ge eheene, nitakugaamba orurimi.
Kweego, ahagiro hoosi hano mukwiikumania kusabha, ndeenda abhasubhe bhagororokye amabhoko iguru okusabha. Bhakore ego kwa amiiseego mazomu, bhasabhe bhatana obhuhaari naabhe kuhakana.
Kweego ndeenda abhakari bhiibhoohe kyeego ekweenderwa, bhabhe ne eteemo nzomu na kusuuhu. Bhataseega kungʼarira kwo okusuka eziinzweeri,
kasi kwo okwiibhoha ebhigiro bhye ezahaabu na bhino bhikubharyabharya, kasi eziingibho zyo obhuguri bhukuru.
Nawe bhabhe ne eteemo nzomu, kyeego bhakweenderwa abhakari bhano bhiikiriirye kumuseengera Taatabhugya.
Hano abhakari bhakubha bhareega, bhabhe abhiitegeereri na abhiigwa.
Nitakubhaha abhakari omweeya gwo okweegya naabhe okukaangata abhasubhe, nawe bhabhe abhiitegeereri.
Niragaambeego, kwo okubha Taatabhugya akabhuumba Adaamu kubhweemero, okumara Haawa.
Naabhe Adaamu ataangʼeenereerwe, nawe omukari niwe akangʼeenererwa, akasarya obhuswaagyo bhwa Taatabhugya.
Nawe abhakari bharasuungʼaana obhutuurya kwe enzira yo okwiibhura abhaana, kyeego bhakugeenderera kwiikara mubhwiikirirya, obhuseegi, obhuhoreeru no okubha na kusuuhu.

footnotes.text: Okusuka eziinzweeri, ku Kizanaki bhaari bharabhuga, okuruka kaswa.
